assignmentHtml.task: Research Celine Dept YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (1) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (2) Operator - who runs this channel? (3) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (4) Operating location and displayed country. (5) Languages. (6) Primary content category. (7) Content supply model. (8) Representative works. Provide direct source URLs.
assignmentHtml.context: Celine Dept is #28/#29 with ~64B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. Need verifiable facts with source links.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for Celine Dept with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml:
Celine Dept YouTube Channel — Dossier

1. Stable Channel ID & Canonical URL

  • Channel ID: UC1a2ZCw7tugRZYRMnecNj3A
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/@CelineDept (handle: @CelineDept)
  • Also accessible via: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC1a2ZCw7tugRZYRMnecNj3A
  • Confirmed by YouTube's own about-page metadata shown in Google indexing (Joined May 3, 2023, Belgium) and by Wikidata entry Q87749922 which lists the same channel ID and handle.

2. Operator

The channel is operated by Céline Dept herself — a Belgian influencer born 8 December 1999 in Ostend, West Flanders, to a Belgian father and Tunisian mother. She is described as a TikToker, YouTuber, actor, and influencer. She previously co-ran a separate joint channel (Celine & Michiel / CEMI, channel ID UClk5AUhvoAzN41inRfdLPYw, created 30 June 2019) with her partner Michiel Callebaut, but the CEMI channel has had no new uploads for approximately a year as of mid-2026 per VRT NWS reporting. The personal @CelineDept channel is her solo venture, launched May 2023.

3. Channel Creation Date & Earliest Still-Public Upload

  • Created: 3 May 2023 (YouTube shows Joined May 3, 2023 on the channel's about page).
  • Earliest still-public upload: My 1st Subscriber?! 🥺🎉 #thankyou (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1q-WhG727G8), uploaded 3 May 2023. It currently has ~96.8 million views and 4.5 million likes. This video documents her receiving her first subscriber and was uploaded on the same day the channel was created.

4. Operating Location & Displayed Country

  • Operating location: Belgium (born and based in Ostend, West Flanders).
  • Displayed country: Belgium (🇧🇪), as shown on YouTube's about page metadata and confirmed by Communitrics ranking data (Country: 🇧🇪 Belgium). CreatorDB also states she is "based in BEL."

5. Languages

  • Primary languages: Dutch (Flemish) and English (per Wikidata Q87749922 statement "languages spoken, written or signed: English, Dutch").
  • She is Flemish-speaking; many videos carry closed captions/subtitles. She also speaks French (as do many Belgians) and has made content touching on French-language culture, but French is not listed as a primary channel language.

6. Primary Content Category

  • Sports — specifically Football & Sport. CreatorDB classifies her niche as Football & Sport and states "their content sits in the football & sport space." Communitrics lists her under Category: Sports. Wikipedia describes her as known for "content related to football, dance, lip syncs, and pranks." Her channel features football challenges, meet-and-greets with global football stars, and sports entertainment.

7. Content Supply Model

  • High-frequency, self-produced daily output. Channel bio reads: "Subscribe For New Videos Every Day ⚽️…Hi, my name is Celine & I love football! Welcome to my channel where you'll see all kind of challenges. Enjoy 🥳".
  • CreatorDB reports ~12.8 posts per week and characterizes the model as daily content with a heavy emphasis on YouTube Shorts mixed with longer-form challenge/vlog videos.
  • Content is independently produced (her company CDMC Works handles business operations; net profit €841,740 in 2024 per VRT NWS).

8. Representative Works (by view count)

Title Views Approx. Date
My 1st Subscriber?! 🥺🎉 #thankyou ~96.8M 3 May 2023 (earliest upload)
How I Met Ronaldo ~27–28M June 2026
Whatever You Hit, Win The World Cup ~16M ~April 2026
Whatever You Hit, Win The Champions League ~15M ~April 2026
I Met Messi ~13M ~April 2026
I Created My Own World Cup Tournament ~11M ~May 2026

Other notable collaborations include appearances with Gareth Bale, Neymar, Eden Hazard, Kylian Mbappé, Erling Haaland, and Cristiano Ronaldo. She also appeared in the feature film Rewind (2022) alongside Michiel Callebaut.

Additional Snapshot Data (Context Match)

Per Communitrics snapshot dated 2 September 2026: ~67 million subscribers, 64.4 billion lifetime views (≈961 views/subscriber), ranked #56 globally out of 50,000 tracked channels, and #1 in Belgium.

Sources consulted: Wikipedia (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/C%C3%A9line_Dept), Wikidata (https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q87749922), Communitrics (https://top.communitrics.com/c/UC1a2ZCw7tugRZYRMnecNj3A), CreatorDB (https://creatordb.app/creatorstats/celine-dept/), VRT NWS (https://www.vrt.be/vrtnws/en/2026/07/02/belgian-influencer-celine-dept-overtakes-mrbeast-as-the-worlds-m/), Async (https://async.com/blog/celine-dept/), Wikitubia/Fandom (https://youtube.fandom.com/wiki/Celine_Dept), YouTube video page (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1q-WhG727G8), and Google-indexed YouTube about-page metadata.
